fun {u} {α} e =>
  have __alt := Lean.throwError (Lean.toMessageData "nonexhaustive match");
  have __alt :=
    have x := e;
    pure false;
  have __alt := do
    let __result ←
      liftM
          (Lean.Meta.withNewMCtxDepth do
            let x ←
              Lean.Meta.mkFreshExprMVar
                  (some
                    (((Lean.Expr.const `OfNat [u]).app α).app
                      (Lean.Expr.lit (Lean.Literal.natVal 0))))
            let matches? ←

                  (Lean.Meta.isDefEq
                    ((((Lean.Expr.const `OfNat.ofNat [u]).app α).app
                          (Lean.Expr.lit (Lean.Literal.natVal 0))).app
                      x)
                    e)
            if matches? = true then do
                let a ← Lean.instantiateMVars x
                pure (a, true)
              else pure (x, false))
    if __result.2 = true then
        have i := __result.1;
        pure true
      else __alt;
  __alt
